bank_comparison_note: Independent statistical banks; B−A SE combines bank variances. Delta response SE preserves within-background arm covariance. Descriptive diagnostics do not identify a compute-site effect or establish equivalence.

A.uncertainty_note: Seed-level Monte Carlo uncertainty, conditional survival integrated exactly. Normal/delta intervals are asymptotic diagnostics; very small banks do not provide reliable coverage.

B.uncertainty_note: Seed-level Monte Carlo uncertainty, conditional survival integrated exactly. Normal/delta intervals are asymptotic diagnostics; very small banks do not provide reliable coverage.

uncertainty_note: Seed-level Monte Carlo uncertainty, conditional survival integrated exactly. Normal/delta intervals are asymptotic diagnostics; very small banks do not provide reliable coverage.
